column1: # ruleplace.sh probe table — AUTHOR-WRITTEN, not generated.
# Each probe encodes a criterion from 1.5-criteria-v2.md, which is a human judgement; there is no source to
# generate it from. It is therefore NOT independent evidence that the criteria are covered — only that the
# rules it names sit in the files it names. The B01-B19 fork-fidelity probes are generated separately, from
# charter.md's own allocation table, by ruleplace.sh's `fidelity` mode.
#   present     PATTERN must match the normalized text of FILE
#   absent      PATTERN must NOT match the normalized text of FILE
#   absent-set  PATTERN must NOT match the normalized text of ANY file in the set (FILE is ignored, use -)
#   absent-dispatched  same, but over the six DISPATCHED files only -- charter.md is a manifest that is
#               never given to an agent, so a pointer it contains cannot dangle in anyone's prompt.
# ANCHOR is a literal substring used by mutation-test.sh to build the deletion/relocation mutant.
#   Use "-" for absent/absent-set rules (their mutant is insertion, see mutants.tsv).
